results.title: The US and Canada are talking trade. That doesn’t mean they’re near a deal.
results.content: Washington and Ottawa have intensified their discussions over the past week, but have yet to offer concessions.

results.title: Quebec’s separatist leader threatens to play spoiler at Carney’s EU summit
results.content: Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon says Ottawa would rather he “serve shrimp cocktail” at a function than stage one, and alleges a “serious lack of respect.”

results.title: EU eyes global tax deal revenue to boost next budget
results.content: European Council President António Costa is pushing national capitals to agree new EU-wide levies to finance the budget.

results.title: EU prepares for a grim future with new climate-proofing law
results.content: The Commission says it's not giving up on slashing emissions but acknowledges that's no longer enough.

results.title: Frontex soll soziale Medien auf Hinweise zu illegaler Migration überwachen
results.content: Die EU-Grenzschutzagentur Frontex soll künftig soziale Netzwerke beobachten dürfen, um Informationen über Migrationsbewegungen zu sammeln.

results.title: EIB to sign framework deal with Canada on critical raw materials
results.content: Deal marks concrete step toward closer ties between the EU and Canada.

results.title: EU divisions persist on ‘associate member’ label for Canada
results.content: The bloc can't agree on controversial status just 48 hours before Montreal summit.

results.title: Frontex gets power to track migration talk on social media
results.content: Frontex will monitor publicly accessible social media content in a bid to stay ahead of illegal migration.

results.title: French government mulled blocking social networks and mobile internet amid protests
results.content: Paris was in touch with telecom operators in the week leading up to Oct. 24 to examine ways of restricting access to social networks.

results.title: French MPs will vote on Sánchez-style amnesty plan for undocumented workers
results.content: Presidential candidate Raphaël Glucksmann is expected to endorse the measure, which would grant amnesty to hundreds of thousands of unauthorized immigrants.
